javafmt third-party runtime components
Each artifact directory preserves its unmodified upstream POM and legal notices.
runtime-dependencies.json records exact versions, original JAR/POM and notice SHA-256
checksums, declared licenses, and version-specific source archive URLs.
The Eclipse components are available as source under EPL-2.0 at those URLs.
These artifacts retain their upstream licenses; javafmt MIT licensing does not relicense them.
JNA offers Apache-2.0 or LGPL-2.1-or-later; javafmt uses the Apache-2.0 option.
Full Eclipse license: licenses/EPL-2.0.txt. Other full licenses remain in artifact directories.
No TurboJ classes, test/benchmark dependencies or OpenJDK corpus are part of this CLI.
Generated offline by scripts/collect-notices.py from the actual resolved runtime report.
